dashboard.label: Corpus Shape: stats + eval + rex
dashboard.description: Synthetic; generic field names only — mirrors the dominant eval/stats/rex pipeline shape, NOT any real corpus content.

search.query: index=app sourcetype=applog | eval is_error=if(status>=500, 1, 0) | stats sum(is_error) as errors, count as total by host | eval error_pct=round(errors*100/total, 2)
index=app | rex field=message "user=(?<userId>\w+)" | stats count by userId | sort -count | head 20
